title: "Technical systems manual"
number-sections: false

This manual covers the technical systems behind the shop's app: running it,
the database and its tests, the automatic checks on GitHub, publishing, and
the AI that reads vaccine paperwork. It is written for the person
responsible for keeping them running. Groomers and managers do not need
these procedures.

Each procedure is numbered and follows the same order: Purpose, Applies to,
Before you begin, Procedure, Result, and If something goes wrong. Reference
pages, such as SYS-01, explain how to use them instead.
